video.title: Purple Belt Changed Everything: Coaching, Ego, Real Progress
video.description:
Purple belt changed how I trained because it changed how I taught. In episode three of The BJJ Belt Journey, I talk about coaching competitors, tailoring intensity to the person in front of me, building a focused game, using difficult positions to learn, and why teaching accelerated my own progress.

More from Toby on Fitness Tech: https://tobyonfitnesstech.com
